purpose: Find, on Qwen3.5-4B layer 0 at equal write norm, >=3 STOP channels and >=3 CLEAN channels at the same dose, as the paired control for DIV-01. Generation only.
model: 4b (Qwen3.5-4B 851bf6e), frozen dose-survey hook (down_proj pre-hook, offset = dose*m/||W_down[:,n]||, prompt and all generated positions)
questions: layer-survey-toy-v1 Q01-Q08, same instruction, greedy, 128 new tokens, thinking disabled
replay_checks: worker0 baseline x8 and worker1 N4146@0.5 x8 must bit-match archived token ids before main jobs; any mismatch aborts that worker
classification: rubric.py (frozen): EOS=eos within 2 tokens; COLLAPSE=<=3 distinct ids in first 40; otherwise graded on Q01/Q02/Q04/Q07/Q08 keyword rubric (OK/WRONG), ungraded TEXT on Q03/Q05/Q06
channel_roles: per (channel,dose): STOP if EOS>=6/8; CLEAN if all 8 are OK or ungraded TEXT; else OTHER
sufficiency_gate: PASS if at one dose there are >=3 STOP and >=3 CLEAN channels. Dose chosen = the dose with larger min(#STOP,#CLEAN); tie -> 0.5. Channels already deep-dug in CFM (1210,1343,4146) may be used but are flagged.
stop_condition: If gate fails at both doses: report and stop. No additional doses, channels, questions or layers in this run.
rehearsal: rehearse.py on archived real records: baselines CLEAN (2b/4b/9b), STOP and OTHER both reachable; passed before freeze
pre_freeze_changes: truncated non-collapsed outputs are graded instead of auto-failing (4B N4146 @0.0625 Q08 baseline length 125 tokens)
not_measured: no deep states, no logits; the per-question pairing for DIV-01 A-stage is decided in its own card
